tasks.subject: Task 1: Multi-dex primitives in hyperliquid.js
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add dex discovery (cached), dex->collateral map (cached), dex-aware getClearinghouseState, and pure mergeAccounts, unit-tested.

**Files:**
- Modify: hyperliquid.js (extend getClearinghouseState; append getPerpDexs, getDexCollateral, mergeAccounts, _resetDexCaches)
- Test: test/hyperliquid.test.js (append)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- getClearinghouseState(address,opts,dex) adds dex only when provided (back-compat)
- getPerpDexs returns [{name:null,fullName:'Main'},...builder] and caches within TTL
- getDexCollateral Map(null->'USDC', builder->symbol via meta+spotMeta); null on failure
- mergeAccounts sums null-safely, concatenates positions tagged {dex,collateral}, counts only real positions

**Verify:** npm test

```json:metadata
{"files": ["hyperliquid.js", "test/hyperliquid.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["dex-aware getClearinghouseState", "getPerpDexs normalize+cache", "getDexCollateral mapping+degrade", "mergeAccounts sums/tags/null-safe"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Aggregate across dexs in assembleAccount
tasks.description:
**Goal:** assembleAccount fetches every dex's clearinghouseState in parallel and returns one merged, persisted payload; main-dex failure throws, builder-dex failures skipped.

**Files:**
- Modify: account.js (imports; rewrite assembleAccount)
- Test: test/account.test.js (replace)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- merged positions from main+builder dexs; equity/uPnL summed; positions carry dex+collateral
- failing builder dex skipped; failing main dex throws
- snapshot stores aggregated equity; fills/realized unchanged

**Verify:** npm test

```json:metadata
{"files": ["account.js", "test/account.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["aggregates main+builder", "skip failing builder dex", "throw on main failure", "aggregated snapshot"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: WS hub refresh nudge instead of main-dex paint
tasks.description:
**Goal:** On main-dex webData2, broadcast {type:'refresh'} (not main-dex-only account/snapshot); move snapshot writing fully to the REST path.

**Files:**
- Modify: ws-server.js (stream.on('account') handler)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- webData2 update -> broadcast {type:'refresh'} to watchers
- no snapshot write / no account|snapshot broadcast from webData2 handler
- fills->realized path unchanged

**Verify:** npm test (no regressions; ws-server untested by convention) + coordinator manual smoke

```json:metadata
{"files": ["ws-server.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["refresh nudge on webData2", "no snapshot/account broadcast there", "fills->realized unchanged"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Frontend unified multi-dex view
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Drive the view from REST (refetch on refresh nudge + always-on 30s poll + manual) and label each position with its collateral.

**Files:**
- Modify: public/app.js (state, ws onmessage, scheduleRefresh, polling always-on, renderAccount coin cell)
- Modify: public/index.html (aggregation note)
- Modify: public/styles.css (.dex-note)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- {type:'refresh'} -> debounced refetch of /api/account + history
- 30s poll runs continuously (builder-dex changes within <=30s)
- positions show collateral (e.g. xyz:SP500 · USDC); missing collateral renders coin alone

**Verify:** node --check public/app.js + coordinator manual smoke

```json:metadata
{"files": ["public/app.js", "public/index.html", "public/styles.css"], "verifyCommand": "node --check public/app.js", "acceptanceCriteria": ["refresh->debounced refetch", "continuous 30s poll", "collateral label"]}
```
